sources.snippet: Architecture Overview Relevant source files τ₀-VLA is a hierarchical robot foundation model designed for long-horizon manipulation tasks. The system decouples high-level semantic reasoning from low-level motor control, utilizing a Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbone integrated with a specialized action expert trained via Conditional Flow Matching (CFM).
